name: cannibal.r_caol_first_smoke_open_window_escape_factor_v1
description: Native window-opening causal probe in a second disposable continuation copied from the already-saved open-reference TestSetup00. Keeps the previous first-light baseline and original owner reference untouched.

steps.label: resume_saved_closed_room_world
steps.expected_visible_fact: Resume the exact saved task-owned TestSetup00 world without fixture installation or world replacement.

steps.label: no_fixture_install_on_saved_world_continuation
steps.expected_visible_fact: Registry continuation launches with no fixture declared; saved profile/world is already present.

steps.label: observe_open_reference_first_light
steps.objective: Continue the saved, task-owned open-reference fire at night. The source-bound diagnostic identified the real brazier at [3159,3449,0] as exposure=contained, visibility_score=0. Walk to the nearest relevant closed window at [3163,3450,0], open it through ordinary gameplay only, return to the observation tile, and inspect whether that exact brazier source becomes light-viable. The profile was copied from an already-saved checkpoint, so this probe cannot alter the previous baseline or owner reference.
proof_targets: current runtime source/profile/build binding and no fixture installation or save replacement
safe mode OFF verified before movement; advertised toggle only if it is currently on
native movement to the audited closed window [3163,3450,0] nearest the brazier east side
native gameplay opens that exact window; record native receipt, tile and in-game minute
same real brazier remains burning at [3159,3449,0] with no injected state
source-bound light adapter logs for live_light@3159,3449,0 after opening, including exposure and rejection/acceptance reason
return to safe two-tile observation position, quicksave, and graceful cleanup
invariants: use only ordinary advertised native actions; no debug mutation, injected signal or raw keyboard input
test copy is derived from the saved task-owned baseline; never modify baseline profile or owner reference
confirm safe mode OFF before movement/wait; toggle only if it is on
no camp is present in this copy; make no cannibal admission/dispatch claim

evidence_contract.claim: On a fresh disposable continuation of the task-owned saved open reference, opening the nearby closed window through ordinary native gameplay changes the exact brazier source exposure and may make its first-light signal viable. This remains signal-only; no cannibal camp exists.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: Preserve baseline and owner save; credit only fresh source-bound native geometry, fire, light/smoke and saved-state evidence.
